override_evm_target.reason: `mcopy` needs a Cancun target, and Istanbul is pre-Cancun and accepted by every supported solc, so the name stays free at every language version.

expected_solc_divergence.reason: From '0.8.35' solc warns that 'mcopy' will be promoted to Yul reserved identifier in the future (`Warning 5470`) while the built-in is unavailable. Slang models the name as either reserved or free, with no grace-period warning, so it stays silent. Neither side rejects the declaration, which is what this test asserts.
